10001.title: Connect HMAC: hash the raw body
10001.line: Compute HMAC-SHA256 with the shared secret over the raw body as received; re-serializing parsed JSON changes whitespace and key order.

10002.title: Apps steps need installed extension apps
10002.line: Maestro apps steps (Read, Store Files, Writeback) appear only after an admin installs and authorizes the extension app from the App Center.

10003.title: Embedded web form: clientUserId and prefill
10003.line: Embedded instances need clientUserId (up to 100 chars, from your system); prefill with formValues keyed by field names from Configurations:getForm.

10004.title: Authorization code lives 120 seconds
10004.line: An authorization code is valid only 120 seconds (2 minutes); exchange it at /oauth/token immediately, not after queueing.

10005.title: Locked after an app goes live
10005.line: Once an extension app is published live, its distribution type (public/private) cannot change and current regions cannot be removed.

10006.title: Maestro events need JSON SIM
10006.line: Maestro workflow events are delivered only in JSON SIM; keep an XML feed and add a separate JSON SIM configuration for workflow events.

10007.title: Composite templates: sequence order
10007.line: Templates apply in sequence order, later overwriting earlier; give the server template a lower sequence so its role exists before the inline template maps it.

10008.title: Admin consent for internal apps
10008.line: Internal app admin consent is granted in Docusign Admin > Connected Apps; needs Access Management and a claimed domain (not the external-app consent URL).

10009.title: Maestro events: JSON SIM only
10009.line: Maestro workflow events are only available with the JSON SIM message format, not XML Aggregated; HMAC is unrelated.

10010.title: Revoking consent and existing tokens
10010.line: Revoking consent invalidates refresh tokens and blocks new ones, but an issued access token keeps working until it expires (Auth Code: 8 hours).

10011.title: Sending connected fields by API
10011.line: Call TabInfo:GetConnectedFieldsTabGroups, put data in each tab's extensionData, then Envelopes:create (not envelope customFields).

10012.title: Go-Live: Review Expired after 90 days
10012.line: A key that passed review but is not submitted to a production account within 90 days becomes Review Expired and must be reviewed again.

10013.title: Production auth host and base URI
10013.line: After Go-Live use account.docusign.com as OAuth host and JWT aud; take account_id and base_uri from /oauth/userinfo, never hard-code a server.

10014.title: Embedded workflow step restrictions
10014.line: Embedded workflow instances support only Phone Authentication in Verify Someone's Identity and do not support focused view in Send Documents for Signature.

10015.title: Maestro API scope: aow_manage
10015.line: Maestro API calls (trigger, pause, resume, cancel) need the aow_manage scope in addition to normal eSignature scopes, not extended.

10016.title: Connect listener: ack fast, idempotent
10016.line: Non-2xx or timeout triggers retries; return 2xx once validated and queued, process asynchronously, and make processing idempotent (e.g. envelope ID plus event).

10017.title: Build trigger_inputs from trigger schema
10017.line: Workflows:getWorkflowTriggerRequirements returns trigger_input_schema (names, types, defaults); build trigger_inputs from it, not from a past instance's inputs.

10018.title: createRecipient must match exactly
10018.line: EnvelopeViews:createRecipient matches email, userName and clientUserId exactly as set at envelope creation; recipientId is not the lookup key.

10019.title: Organization-level Connect scope
10019.line: One org-level Connect configuration covers sent and received envelopes for all or selected accounts, always JSON SIM; no per-account configurations needed.

10020.title: Deleting a published workflow
10020.line: Pause it, unpublish once no instances run, then delete; only paused workflows with no running instances can be unpublished. Deletion is permanent.

10021.title: Extension app infrastructure needs
10021.line: Non-conforming APIs need an API proxy mapping to the Docusign action contract; firewalls and ad blockers must allow Docusign requests and App Center install.

10022.title: JWT token: 1 hour, no refresh
10022.line: JWT Grant access tokens last 1 hour with no refresh token; mint a new JWT (exp at most 1 hour after iat).

10023.title: Embedded signing required parameters
10023.line: Embedded signing envelopes always need status sent and a non-null clientUserId on the recipient; returnUrl is not one of the two required parameters.

10024.title: Filtering agreements in one query
10024.line: GetAgreementsList filters on fields like parties.name_in_agreement and provisions.expiration_date (gte/lte) and pages with ctoken, avoiding per-agreement GetAgreement calls.

10025.title: Template reference model roles
10025.line: The template reference model uses templateId plus templateRoles, each giving name and email and matched to the template by roleName.

10026.title: Manifest: connectionsReference
10026.line: Each action names its auth credentials via connectionsReference, which must match a defined connection name; hence connection names must be unique.

10027.title: account_id and base_uri from userinfo
10027.line: For every flow, call /oauth/userinfo and use account_id and base_uri from the account where is_default is true.

10028.title: Navigator scope for getAgreement
10028.line: Agreement Manager uses eSignature-style OAuth tokens but needs a Navigator scope; getAgreement requires adm_store_unified_repo_read (not aow_manage).

10029.title: Publishing a private app
10029.line: Private apps are shared by adding each production account ID (GUID) after approval; each shows Pending until its admin accepts in the App Center.

10030.title: Go-Live error: integration type mismatch
10030.line: An error instead of the account list means the key's integration type does not match the type of account you logged into.

10031.title: Signing URL lifetime: 5 minutes
10031.line: The embedded signing URL is single-use and expires in about 5 minutes; call createRecipient only when the signer is ready.

10032.title: Remote web form redirect via brand
10032.line: Remote web form redirect after signing works only through a brand's Signing Completed destination URL (e.g. brandId), not returnUrl.

10033.title: Standalone web form results
10033.line: Standalone configurations only collect data and never create envelopes; a submitted instance has status SUBMITTED, formValues, and an empty envelopes array.

10034.title: Connected fields by API sequence
10034.line: Sequence: TabInfo:GetConnectedFieldsTabGroups, place data in each tab's extensionData, then Envelopes:create; do not call the app's endpoints directly.

10035.title: Hourly API limit
10035.line: Default 3,000 calls per hour per account, shared by all integrations calling it, resetting at the top of the hour (not rolling per key).

10036.title: Web form instance token: 5 minutes
10036.line: The createInstance instanceToken expires after five minutes (fixed); Instances:refreshToken with the instance id issues a new token for the same instance.

10037.title: Connected fields for proprietary data
10037.line: Proprietary data in your own system of record, checked while filling the envelope, uses connected fields at Add Fields and signing.

10038.title: API-triggered workflow start method
10038.line: When a server triggers a workflow via triggerWorkflow with trigger_inputs, use From an API call; it can still be embedded via the returned URL.

10039.title: Agreement data as RAG source
10039.line: GetAgreementsList/GetAgreement return AI-extracted and user-corrected parties and provisions, a documented RAG source; key the index by agreementId for citations.

10040.title: Polling limit vs Connect
10040.line: Poll each envelope at most once per 15 minutes; use Connect for changes (not counted against limits) and listStatusChanges for catch-up.

10041.title: ID verification on recipients
10041.line: Request ID verification with the recipient's identityVerification.workflowId; available workflow IDs come from IdentityVerifications:list.

10042.title: Envelope lock for in-process edits
10042.line: To change an in-process envelope safely: EnvelopeLocks:create, EnvelopeRecipientTabs:update, then release; the lock blocks recipient action meanwhile.

10043.title: Storing files from a workflow
10043.line: Storing completed files from a Maestro step uses the file output cloud storage (File IO) extension; file archive is legacy.

10044.title: Embedded integration classification
10044.line: Customers using Docusign through an account you own and control, without their own accounts, is an Embedded integration requiring an ISV Embed partner license.

10045.title: Functional test prerequisites
10045.line: Functional tests require a successful connection test and successful extension tests for every extension; those are the integration tests.

10046.title: Anchor tabs: use unique strings
10046.line: Anchor tabs are placed at every occurrence of anchorString; use a unique (often hidden white) string like /sn1/ at the target only.

10047.title: JWT Grant for unattended services
10047.line: Service integrations with no user use JWT Grant: after one-time consent, sign a new JWT with the RSA private key whenever a token is needed.

10048.title: Building the request URL
10048.line: Request URL is {base_uri}/restapi/v2.1/accounts/{accountId}/...; both come from /oauth/userinfo, not the user GUID (sub) or a hard-coded host.

10049.title: JWT consent needs impersonation
10049.line: JWT consent must include impersonation (scope=signature impersonation); the JWT payload scope then lists only API scopes like signature.

10050.title: recipient-completed for intermediate capture
10050.line: recipient-completed fires as each recipient finishes, so Connect can save documents after the first signer, before the next; envelope-completed comes only at the end.

10051.title: Org-level Connect behaviour
10051.line: Organization-level Connect supports only JSON SIM, and logging and require acknowledgement (auto-retry) are enabled automatically.

10052.title: Voiding an envelope
10052.line: Void with Envelopes:update setting status voided plus a voidedReason; voiding is permanent and ends the lifecycle for all recipients.

10053.title: Promoted key: config not copied
10053.line: Promotion duplicates the key with the same value, but secrets and redirect URIs are not copied; add them in production Apps and Keys.

10054.title: Prepare Document Template use
10054.line: Prepare Document Template generates varying document content from workflow variables with conditional show/hide; follow it with Send Documents for Signature.

10055.title: PKCE in Public Auth Code Grant
10055.line: Send code_challenge (S256 hash of a random string) on /oauth/auth, then the original string as code_verifier on /oauth/token instead of a secret.

10056.title: Pause workflow vs cancel instance
10056.line: pauseNewWorkflowInstances blocks new instances while active ones run; cancelWorkflowInstance stops one instance's further steps, keeping collected data.

10057.title: Connect advantages over polling
10057.line: Connect messages don't count against API limits, arrive only on change, and remove polling logic; polling stays limited to once per envelope per 15 minutes.

10058.title: AI agreement summary operation
10058.line: AI summaries come only from CreateAgreementSummary, POST .../agreements/{agreementId}/ai/actions/summarize; there is no GET summary endpoint.

10059.title: Refreshing a connected fields model
10059.line: After the data model changes, refresh the app connection in the App Center so Docusign re-calls Get Type Names and Get Type Definitions.

10060.title: Focused view frameAncestors and messageOrigins
10060.line: frameAncestors lists your origin plus https://apps.docusign.com (apps-d in demo); messageOrigins is a single-element array with https://apps.docusign.com.

20001.title: Confidential token Basic header
20001.line: Confidential token requests use Authorization: Basic base64(integrationKey:secretKey) with a colon and no spaces.

20002.title: Effect of cancelling an instance
20002.line: Cancelling a workflow instance stores data collected so far and triggers no further steps for that instance; it does not pause the workflow.

20003.title: Data IO for system of record
20003.line: Reading and writing a system of record inside a Maestro workflow uses Data IO read/write steps; connected fields are not supported in Maestro.

20004.title: Editing workflow with active instances
20004.line: Editing participants or steps does not change active instances; only new instances reflect the changes.

20005.title: Recovering events after long outage
20005.line: Connect retries back off then run daily for 15 days only; use the failure log and ConnectEvents:retryForEnvelopes to republish older failures.

20006.title: Branding a standalone web form
20006.line: Standalone instances cannot get a brand via API; select the brand under Branding on the configuration's Preview tab (works for both configuration types).

20007.title: Flow for native mobile apps
20007.line: Native apps that cannot securely store a secret, with individual user sign-in, use Public Authorization Code Grant with PKCE.

20008.title: Raising the hourly limit
20008.line: Admins use Update Hourly Limit in the API Usage Center only if the plan allows it, no Support limit applies, and apps are efficient.

20009.title: Integration key after promotion
20009.line: Go-Live duplicates the key: same value works in developer and production; tied to one production account for management but can call any account.

20010.title: Composite templates: document precedence
20010.line: Each composite template object contributes at most one document, and a document property overrides its templates' documents; order follows the array.

20011.title: Action template identifier
20011.line: An action's Docusign-predefined template identifier specifies its action contract: request/response contract and the extension points that trigger it.

20012.title: Agreement-driven renewal orchestration
20012.line: Find expiring agreements with GetAgreementsList (provisions.expiration_date filter), then trigger a published Maestro workflow per agreement via the Workflow Builder API.

20013.title: Idempotent create with transactionId
20013.line: A sender-generated transactionId makes Envelopes:create safe to retry; resending the same value does not create a second envelope.

20014.title: Embedded web form redirect: returnUrl
20014.line: Template-based embedded-signing web form instances redirect via returnUrl in Instances:createInstance; without it the thank you page shows.

20015.title: Connect for post-completion write-back
20015.line: Writing signer-updated data back to a business system after completion is a custom Connect use case (envelope-completed with tab data), using no API calls.

20016.title: Post-signing redirect: remote vs embedded
20016.line: Remote signers are redirected via brand Destination URLs; embedded signers via returnUrl set in EnvelopeViews:createRecipient.

20017.title: Implicit vs Public Auth Code Grant
20017.line: Implicit (legacy) returns the token straight to the browser with no code exchange; Public Auth Code adds a PKCE-protected exchange and is recommended.

20018.title: CORS for single-page apps
20018.line: eSignature CORS is configured on the integration key in Apps and Keys by listing allowed origins, not via headers the SPA sends.

20019.title: workflow-completed Connect event
20019.line: workflow-completed fires when all workflow steps are done by all participants, including steps after signing; envelope-completed does not cover those.

20020.title: Third-party integration key
20020.line: Using a partner integration that requires you to supply your own integration key is classified as a Third-party integration key.

20021.title: External admin consent: coid claim
20021.line: Requesting openid returns an ID token whose coid claim lists organizations that granted admin consent; this is the only way to get that list.

20022.title: Embedded sending with createSender
20022.line: Embedded sending: create the envelope as draft (status created), then EnvelopeViews:createSender so the user edits and sends in-app.

20023.title: Promoting a workflow to production
20023.line: Export from demo and import into production (keeps configuration and mappings, adds referenced web forms/templates); production Maestro base is https://api.docusign.com/v1.

20024.title: Least-privilege consent and JWT scopes
20024.line: Consent must cover all scopes used plus impersonation (signature aow_manage impersonation); the JWT payload requests only API scopes (signature aow_manage).

20025.title: Data and plan after Go-Live
20025.line: Production is separate: migrate templates and use their production IDs, and confirm the production plan has every feature used in development.

20026.title: Rendering an embedded web form
20026.line: createInstance returns a shared formUrl and a per-session instanceToken; Docusign JS builds formUrl#instanceToken=... and mounts the form.

20027.title: Data verification for standard types
20027.line: Standard verifiable types (e.g. business FEIN) without your own registry use the data verification extension at the eSignature extension point.

20028.title: Envelope-level webhook limitation
20028.line: Envelope-level webhooks (eventNotification) are configured only when sending, so they cannot cover envelopes received from external parties.

20029.title: Remote web form instance request
20029.line: Remote instances identify users by roleName in recipients (no clientUserId needed); tags add metadata returned by getInstance and listInstances.

20030.title: extended scope: rolling refresh
20030.line: With extended, the refresh token expires 30 days after the last successful refresh; without it, 30 days after original issue.

20031.title: Public app regional availability
20031.line: Public apps use publicationRegions (public only) to control which regions can install the app from the production App Center.

20032.title: Choosing composite templates
20032.line: Only composite templates apply multiple server templates plus extra documents in one envelope in a single API call.

20033.title: App review and publishing facts
20033.line: Review covers business, technical, security and functional aspects; public apps need production URLs in the registration before review.

20034.title: Connected fields results via Connect
20034.line: Connected fields verification results arrive via the extension-executed event, JSON SIM only; add a separate configuration rather than changing an XML feed.

20035.title: Catch-up with listStatusChanges
20035.line: After missed Connect messages, call Envelopes:listStatusChanges with a from_date overlapping the outage; a few list calls replace many individual GETs.

20036.title: Paging GetAgreementsList with ctoken
20036.line: GetAgreementsList pages with limit (page size) and ctoken, an opaque continuation token for the next page.

20037.title: Multiple HMAC keys and headers
20037.line: Each HMAC key (up to 100) adds an X-DocuSign-Signature-N header with HMAC-SHA256 of the body; matching any one proves authenticity and integrity.

20038.title: Deleting an agreement
20038.line: DeleteAgreement is DELETE /v1/accounts/{accountId}/agreements/{agreementId}; one of four agreement operations (list, get, delete, create summary).

20039.title: Extension app vs API integration
20039.line: No-code functionality inside customers' envelopes and Maestro workflows, installed by admins, is an extension app published to the App Center.

20040.title: Tracking a triggered instance
20040.line: Save the instance ID from the trigger response; getWorkflowInstance returns its status, start/end times and started_by.

20041.title: JWT RSA keys after promotion
20041.line: RSA key pairs are not copied on promotion; add one to the production key in Apps and Keys; sign with its private key.

20042.title: Refresh token behaviour
20042.line: A refresh returns a new access token and new refresh token, and the previous access token is no longer valid.

20043.title: returnUrl event parameter
20043.line: Docusign appends event=... (signing_complete, cancel, decline, ttl_expired) to returnUrl; read it, but confirm final status via Connect, not the redirect.

20044.title: Where connected fields verify
20044.line: Connected fields verify data in the eSignature Add Fields view and during signing, when the signer completes required fields.

20045.title: Web form envelope creation timing
20045.line: Template-based web forms: remote instance creates the envelope when createInstance is processed; embedded instance creates it when the first user submits.

20046.title: Verification results via extension-executed
20046.line: Verification results are retrieved programmatically via the Connect extension-executed event, JSON SIM only; also shown in envelope history and certificate.

20047.title: Switching extension app environment
20047.line: Update connection settings (clientId, clientSecret, auth settings in customConfig) and each action's and capability's params.uri to production URLs.

20048.title: Templates after go-live
20048.line: Go-live promotes the key, not templates; the template must exist in production, with a new template ID the app must use.

20049.title: From a Link start method
20049.line: From a Link suits participant-initiated workflows via a URL on a website or auto-email, needing no server or token.

20050.title: Envelope-level webhook via eventNotification
20050.line: eventNotification on Envelopes:create is API-only envelope-level Connect, needs no account configuration, and can point each envelope to its own URL.

20051.title: Data IO Read and Writeback steps
20051.line: Data IO extension apps read and write structured system-of-record data, appearing in Workflow Builder as Read and Writeback steps.

20052.title: Verify identity before revealing data
20052.line: Steps can be sequenced so Verify Someone's Identity (after Set Up Invite) precedes a web form showing sensitive pre-filled data.

20053.title: User-corrected extraction values
20053.line: After a user modifies an AI-extracted value in the UI, later GET requests return the user-updated value, not the original extraction.

20054.title: IsRequiredForVerifyingType decorator
20054.line: IsRequiredForVerifyingType marks properties required to verify an object (shown with an asterisk); add it per property on an already-verifiable concept.

20055.title: Burst limit
20055.line: Burst limit is 500 calls per 30 seconds in production (200 in demo), distinct from the hourly limit; throttle and back off using X-RateLimit headers.

20056.title: Aggregate Connect message mode
20056.line: The aggregate option, XML only at account or envelope level, combines similar events (e.g. recipient and envelope complete) into one message.

20057.title: Terminal envelope statuses
20057.line: Completed, declined and voided are terminal: no further API modifications such as adding tabs; correct is not terminal.

20058.title: triggerWorkflow request body
20058.line: TriggerWorkflow body needs instance_name and trigger_inputs, with keys matching trigger_input_schema; wrong field names (name, inputs) cause the 400.

20059.title: Production JWT claims
20059.line: Production JWT: iss = integration key, sub = impersonated user's production GUID, aud = account.docusign.com, exp at most 3600 s after iat.

20060.title: Per-signer events via eventNotification
20060.line: Add recipient-completed to an Envelopes:create eventNotification to get a message as each signer finishes, for that envelope only.
